name: HiAnime Downloader
description: Searches, stream-extracts, and downloads anime series and episodes from HiAnime directly into the Jellyfin media library with an embedded dashboard GUI.
overview: HiAnime downloader and dashboard GUI for Jellyfin Server.

versions.changelog: Initial release: HiAnime search, stream extractor (MegaCloud AES-256-CBC), multi-segment HLS downloader, FFmpeg remuxer, WebVTT subtitle embedder, Jellyfin anime naming, and dashboard Web GUI.
